events.summary: Mycronic receives order for an SLX mask writer 2026-10-20 14:00:00 Mycronic AB (publ) has received an order for an SLX mask writer from an existing customer, for delivery to Europe. The order value is in the range of USD 5-7 million. Delivery of the system is planned for the third quarter of 2027.
